title: Sharing Hearts' Secrets
next_chapter_hook: When those words, "After breaking the Heavenly Way, will you take me away?" fell softly, Chen Ji discovered that his answer might have already been written in the mists of the Tianji Record.

text.content: A crescent moon hung like a hook from the broken eaves of the ruined temple. Chen Ji sat against a cracked stone pillar, his fingertips gently brushing his sleeve—where the Tianji Record Fragment hidden within radiated faint warmth, as if reminding him of the pursuit that would arrive in three hours. His gaze fell upon Ye Qing nearby, her blood-red sleeve cuff glaringly conspicuous under the moonlight.

dialogue.content: "Calculating again?" Ye Qing's voice carried a thread of exhaustion as she tucked the blood-colored token into her sleeve. "Every time you use the Tianji Record, your Heavenly Fate decreases. How many more times can you sustain this?"

text.content: Chen Ji offered no answer. His gaze shifted from Ye Qing's face to the pitch-black night beyond the ruined temple. The three great Sects vying for power, the Demonic Path invasion, the opening of the Ancient Forbidden Land—in this chaotic chess game of turmoil, he had been playing for far too long.

dialogue.content: "Do you know," Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice unusually calm, "before the Tianji Record chose me, I spent an entire three years sweeping fallen leaves at the Tianqing Sect."

text.content: Ye Qing was slightly taken aback. She gazed at this man who calculated every move flawlessly, finding it hard to imagine he had once lived such a卑微 existence. Outside the ruined temple, a few night owl cries added a touch of desolation to the silence.

dialogue.content: "The first year, all the senior brothers stepped on me for entertainment. The second year, my master publicly declared I wasn't even worth the waste." Chen Ji's voice carried no inflection, as if narrating someone else's story. "By the third year... I learned to smile."

text.content: Ye Qing's fingers unconsciously tightened her clothing. She suddenly recalled being taken from her mother's arms by people from the Holy Sect at seven years old, and that desperate plea in her mother's eyes.

dialogue.content: "I too was once someone stepped upon." Ye Qing's voice was soft. "At the Holy Sect, those without value... even breathing is a luxury." She raised her head, and on that eerily beautiful face under the moonlight, a hint of vulnerability actually appeared.

text.content: Chen Ji looked at her. In this moment, he suddenly realized—the woman before him, called the Demonic Path Saint, was so similar to him—both lonely souls forced to grow by fate, both having learned to disguise themselves in darkness.

dialogue.content: "So you understand now, don't you?" A slight smile curved Chen Ji's lips—a smile devoid of any calculation. "From the very beginning, we weren't standing here for the sake of profit."

text.content: Ye Qing stared at him blankly. The Holy Sect had taught her that everything was a transaction, that profit was the only bond. But this man before her was tearing open all her defenses in a way she had never witnessed.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing remained silent for a long while before finally asking softly, "Then why are you willing to tell me all this?"

choices.description: Honestly admitting to one's inner exhaustion, wanting to cast off the disguise
choices.risk_hint: Might be seen as weakness by the other party

dialogue.content: "Because I'm tired." Chen Ji closed his eyes, his voice carrying a thread of exhaustion even he hadn't noticed. "Having calculated for so long, sometimes... I truly wish there was someone who could understand."

Ye Qing's eyes slightly reddened. She suddenly understood why Chen Ji was willing to cooperate with her—not just because her "Demonic Path Mists" could conceal the Tianji Record's aura, but because... they were both people driven into a corner by fate.

choices.description: Directly expressing recognition and respect for Ye Qing
choices.visible_reward: Deepening the emotional bond with Ye Qing
choices.risk_hint: May come across as too direct

dialogue.content: "Because you're worth it." Chen Ji stared directly into her eyes. "When everyone treated me as waste, you chose to believe in me."
Ye Qing's breath caught slightly. People at the Holy Sect never told her "worth it," only "useful" or "useless." Yet this man before her...

choices.description: Proving trust in Ye Qing using the Tianji Record's foresight
choices.visible_reward: Displaying the unique bond between the two
choices.risk_hint: Exposing some details of the Tianji Record's abilities

dialogue.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then said softly, "Because I've seen it with the Tianji Record. In all possible futures... you never betrayed me."
Ye Qing froze. She knew every use of the Tianji Record consumed precious Heavenly Fate—yet Chen Ji had actually used it on her?

text.content: A rustling sound suddenly came from outside the ruined temple, and both tensed alertly. But a moment later they discovered it was merely a wild cat passing by, not pursuers. This brief moment of peace felt so precious in these chaotic times.

dialogue.content: "The year I was seven, my mother was killed on the spot trying to protect me." Ye Qing's voice was soft, yet carried a tranquil composure that comes after traversing hardships. "Since then, I never cried again."

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing. He simply listened quietly—this was the first time since becoming a strategist that he felt "listening" was more important than "speaking." Night wind seeped through the temple's cracks, carrying the chill of early winter.

dialogue.content: "I once had a younger sister too." Chen Ji suddenly said, his voice carrying a subtle tremor. "Her name was Chen Nian... she was taken away by the Holy Sect."

text.content: Ye Qing's body stiffened slightly. She knew of the Holy Sect's internal "Heavenly Fate Lock Key" project—a forbidden experiment using children as sacrifices. If Chen Nian had been selected...

dialogue.content: "I will help you find her." Ye Qing's voice suddenly turned firm. "If the Holy Sect truly is carrying out that project... I know its inner workings better than anyone."

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head, looking at the Demonic Path Saint despised by the world. He suddenly discovered that in this chaotic game of chess, he was no longer alone.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing stood up and walked toward Chen Ji. At this moment, she wanted to...

choices.description: Without any profit motive, just simple reliance
choices.visible_reward: Two lonely hearts finally finding each other
choices.risk_hint: Breaking the delicate balance between the two

dialogue.content: Ye Qing walked to where he stood, slowly knelt down, and then—gently rested her head against his shoulder. "Let me lean on you for a while." Her voice carried a slight tremor. "Just for a while."

text.content: Chen Ji froze. He had calculated countless possibilities, yet this one had never occurred to him. The faint floral fragrance from Ye Qing wafted into his nose, his hand hovering mid-air, unsure where to place it.

choices.description: Expressing support and companionship in the simplest way
choices.risk_hint: May come across as too intimate

dialogue.content: Ye Qing extended her hand and gently grasped Chen Ji's hand. Her fingers were cold, yet carried an unspoken steadiness. "I'm here," she said.

text.content: Chen Ji felt the warmth of that hand. He discovered his tense nerves were gradually relaxing. How many years had it been? He had grown accustomed to bearing everything alone.

choices.description: Choosing a more reserved approach, expressing through mere presence
choices.risk_hint: Might cause Ye Qing to misunderstand as rejection

dialogue.content: Ye Qing didn't draw closer, simply sitting down beside him. Moonlight poured through the broken roof, stretching their shadows long and intertwined.

text.content: Chen Ji glanced at her, the corner of his lips slightly lifting. Though there were no words, in this moment, the unspoken understanding between them needed no proof.

Moonlight flowed like water, bathing two lonely souls. They both knew the Holy Sect's pursuers would not stop, the Heavenly Way's chess game continued, and Chen Nian still waited somewhere unknown for rescue. But at this moment, in this decrepit little temple, they had found each other.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji." Ye Qing suddenly softly called his name, her voice carrying a tenderness unfamiliar even to herself. "After breaking the Heavenly Way... will you take me away?"

text.content: These words were light as a feather, yet fell heavily on Chen Ji's heart. He looked at Ye Qing's expectant gaze and suddenly realized—he had never seen this answer in the Tianji Record. Perhaps some futures... lie beyond heavenly secrets.

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji respond to Ye Qing's question?

choices.description: Making a promise about the future
choices.visible_reward: Making a生死 bond with Ye Qing
choices.risk_hint: Would the Heavenly Way permit such a future to exist?

dialogue.content: Chen Ji extended his hand and gently grasped Ye Qing's hand. "I promise you." His voice was soft, yet carried unwavering certainty. "No matter what the Heavenly Way demands, I will take you away."
Ye Qing's eyes reddened. In all her years, no one had ever made her such a promise. She gripped Chen Ji's hand back, her fingertips trembling slightly.

choices.description: Responding pragmatically, emphasizing the present is more important than the future

dialogue.content: "First survive." Chen Ji said softly. "When we truly break the Heavenly Way, I'll answer this question for you." A hint of cunning flickered in his eyes. "By then, don't regret it."
Ye Qing first stared blankly, then the corner of her lips slightly curved upward. She caught the subtext in Chen Ji's words—this wasn't a rejection, but... another form of promise.

choices.text: Silence, simply pulling her into his embrace
choices.description: Using action instead of words, leaving the deepest imprint on this moment
choices.visible_reward: Two lonely hearts thoroughly intertwining at this moment
choices.risk_hint: Such an emotional act might not fit Chen Ji's usual image

dialogue.content: Chen Ji said nothing. He simply gently pulled Ye Qing into his embrace. This hug carried no profit motive, no calculation—just a response from one lonely soul to another lonely soul.

text.content: Ye Qing's body first stiffened, then slowly relaxed. She closed her eyes, letting tears slide from the corners. At this moment, she was no longer the Demonic Path Saint, no longer a chess piece of the Holy Sect—just a woman yearning for warmth.

The night wind gradually subsided, the moon revealing its face from behind the clouds, scattering soft silver light throughout the decrepit temple. Chen Ji felt the woman in his arms had fallen into a deep sleep, her breathing even and steady. He didn't push her away, simply maintaining this posture quietly. In three hours, the Holy Sect's pursuers would arrive; the Heavenly Way's chess game continued; Chen Nian still waited somewhere unknown for rescue. But at this moment, he simply wanted this moment to linger a little longer. The Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve radiated faint warmth, seemingly reminding him of fate's weight. Yet Chen Ji discovered that with Ye Qing beside him, that burning heat seemed not so unbearable after all.

dialogue.content: "I will find Chen Nian." Chen Ji said softly, his voice audible only to himself. "And then... I will take all of you away." Under the moonlight, his gaze was more determined than ever.
